import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    lt = np.log(t)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*lt + p[2]*t + p[3]*t**2
            + (p[4] + p[5]*t + p[6]*lt)*P
            + (p[7] + p[8]*lt)*P**2 + p[9]*P**3
            + (0.0)*P)
